svg.title: Agentic IAM with SPIFFE/SPIRE — System Architecture
svg.desc: Swimlane architecture diagram. Columns show trust zones (Workload Clients, mTLS Edge, Policy Enforcement Points, Governance, Upstream). Rows show milestone paths (SPIRE identity bootstrap, Capability Minting, M3/M4 tool-b, M4a/M4b Jira, M5 Codex Jira MCP).
svg.text: Agentic IAM with SPIFFE/SPIRE — System Architecture
Columns = trust zones · Rows = milestone paths · Solid arrows = request flow · Dashed arrows = upstream calls
Admits nodes; issues X.509 SVIDs only to registered workloads.
SVIDs are short-lived and automatically rotated.
Unregistered workloads receive no identity and cannot enter the stack.
Workload Clients — hold SPIFFE identity, no upstream credentials
mTLS Edge — Envoy proxies terminate mTLS and inject verified SPIFFE identity header
Policy Enforcement Points — verify token + identity + action + resource + budget before every upstream call
Governance — trusted runtime state, unreachable by callers
Upstream — Jira systems, reachable only via explicit live mode or deterministic mocks
Normal request flow (mTLS, verified identity forwarding, governance checks)
Upstream call — mock (test default) or Jira Cloud (explicit live mode opt-in)
